zen.b1: Sole mobile developer on MyTax, LHDN's official tax filing app, maintaining one Flutter codebase for iOS and Android and a separate HMS codebase for Huawei AppGallery, which runs without Google Mobile Services.
zen.b2: Fixed the refund and audit status screens and login prompts across four iOS releases in ten days as the 2026 filing season opened.
zen.b3: Upgraded the iOS, Android and Huawei builds and moved 25+ dependencies up a major version to meet Google Play's API 36 target and 16 KB memory page requirement, live since May 2026.
zen.b4: Moved the server's push sends to the Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 API, and added topic broadcasts and Android image notifications in the app.
zen.b5: Cleared more than 200 static analysis warnings in each mobile codebase, and added a CI workflow, pre-push checks and the first unit tests to both.
zen.b6: Kept Bahasa Malaysia and English strings aligned with the web platform, and integrated new REST endpoints as the backend team shipped them.

bestinet.meta: Research & Development · Cyberjaya, Selangor · Hybrid · Khazanah K-Youth placement
bestinet.b1: Took over a broken TOTP feature in an internal Flutter authenticator app where the one-time code never appeared on screen, and got it generating and displaying correctly.
bestinet.b2: Traced the failure with a numbered step-by-step trace through the generation chain and found two defects: the controller's init routine was never called from the view layer, and an invalid type cast on a secure-storage read threw on any device that was already enrolled.
bestinet.b3: Hardened the TOTP generation path by wrapping code generation in error handling and making a failed device or secret-key lookup return early instead of generating a code from an empty key.
bestinet.b4: Built the authenticator screen to the design I was given, with a countdown ring tied to the 30-second refresh window and the code rendered digit by digit, then applied the same supplied branding to the app shell and login screen.

pantai.b1: Resolved hardware and software problems for doctors and staff across most departments as they came up, from a desktop that would not start while patients waited to a frozen browser, a printer jam and a patient queue display that had gone offline.
pantai.b2: Monitored the hospital information system and supported staff and doctors who ran into problems with it or with other hospital systems.
pantai.b3: Set up desktop workstations end to end, from peripherals, display and desktop settings to passwords, antivirus and performance checks, with setup notes for whoever maintains them next. Prepared a meeting room for a conference, checking the laptop, projector, camera, audio, battery and network beforehand.

projects.intro: Production work, company work, two personal apps and the university projects that got me started.

projects.bestinet_desc: An internal authenticator app at Bestinet that shows a new one-time code every 30 seconds. The TOTP feature was already written but never put a code on screen, and my job was to find out why and make it work. I traced the generation chain and found two faults: the view never called the controller's init routine, and a bad type cast on a secure-storage read threw on already enrolled devices, where a catch block swallowed the error. I fixed both and made a failed key lookup return early, so a code is never generated from an empty key. Then I built the screen to the design I was given, with a countdown ring and the code laid out digit by digit.
projects.silentsupport_desc: A private place to check in when feelings are heavy and words are hard. Tap one of eight feelings and a calm, pre-written reply appears at once; a freshly written AI reply at the same depth replaces it only if it arrives within 2.5 seconds and passes a server-side tone filter.
projects.halalsaji_desc: An app for finding halal food nearby and seeing how each place was verified. Halal Certified and Muslim Owned are separate badges, because one does not imply the other, and expired certificates and places pending review are flagged too. You can search, filter by halal status, cuisine, meat type or opening hours, save favourites on the phone and open a place in Google Maps. The forms to suggest a restaurant or report wrong details are built so they can never change a halal status on their own. Built solo in June 2026 with Flutter and Provider, with a read-only Firestore data layer ready; for now it runs on sample data.
projects.baglock_desc: My final year project: a bag that opens to a fingerprint and calls for help when it does not. One enrolled finger toggles the servo, unlock on a touch and lock on the next, and with no screen the buzzer does all the talking, a different beep for boot, capture, match and refusal. Three failed matches in a row and it sounds the alarm, reads the GPS and texts a preset number twice, a plain warning then the coordinates to six decimal places. An Arduino Uno cannot listen on three software serial ports at once, so it opens each one in turn and brings the sensor back up afterwards.
projects.bookstore_desc: A bookstore website with separate logins for customers, sellers and admins. Customers browse books, pay by card or cash, get a receipt and leave feedback. Sellers update book details and see the pickup schedule for completed orders, and the admin side lists every purchase.
projects.mytax_desc: Malaysia's official income tax filing app, used by taxpayers nationwide. I am its sole mobile developer on iOS and Android, and on the separate HMS codebase that ships to Huawei AppGallery. My fixes went out in four iOS releases in ten days in the 2026 filing season, and I moved the server's push sends to FCM HTTP v1 and added topic broadcasts and Android image notifications in the app.
